NABL accredited to ISO/IEC 17025:2017 in its own right — certificate NABLT0726AD18713, issued 17/07/2026, valid to 16/07/2030, in the name of the Central Silk Board. Compliance requirements are mandatory, not optional.

Every item marked OPEN-Q. These are decisions only the laboratory can make.
Section 26 — Phase 0: two-day sit-in at the laboratory and collection of all existing forms and registers
howToRead: **If you run the laboratory:** read sections 1 to 10 and section 29. They describe the work in laboratory language, with no programming terms. Sections 7 and 9 are the most important — they describe how a sample will move through the laboratory.
**If you are approving or funding this:** read section 3 (goals and success measures), section 26 (phasing and effort), and section 29 (what this buys the laboratory).
**If you are building it:** read the whole document. Sections 23 to 27 are the technical half. Section 28 lists every decision still outstanding.
**Requirement numbers** such as M3-07 or WF-14 are permanent. Quote them in meetings and emails so everyone is discussing the same line.
**[MUST]** = required for the first release. **[SHOULD]** = important, plan for it. **[LATER]** = deliberately deferred to a later phase.
**OPEN-Q** marks a question the laboratory must answer. Each one has a recommended default so work is not blocked while the answer is pending.
